title: The Gravities — Stuck in the Desert
description: A cinematic, high-octane music video for The Gravities: when a bank robbery gets botched, the band has no choice but to destroy the money, or risk being killed. JWMedia's first official music video — the first time Jacob Willett wrote and directed a music video, made while he was still a film student at SDSU. Winner, Best Music Video at the San Diego Music Awards in May 2026.
